adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` inserts legacy `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` lines directly via SQL: `VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`, bypassing `EmbeddableHost`’s `before_validation` stripping of scheme/path. The new runtime check `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` parses the referer/url with `URI(host)` and then queries `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, which will not match rows stored as `http://example.com` or `https://example.com/1234`. Since the old `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` explicitly tolerated/normalized such entries, this can silently break embedding after upgrade for installs that had schemes/paths in the setting.
